issues.title: [roadmap] verl 26Q4 roadmap
issues.body:
# Model Engine
## Low Precision Training
### Background
**Goals in RL**
- Cheaper rollout and inference-only forwards (ref, teacher, old_log_prob): less memory, less memory traffic, faster GEMM.
- Lower train/rollout mismatch once rollout is quantized: training should see the same quantization as sampling.

**Two routes**
| Route | Training compute | Training speedup | Key issues |
|---|---|---|---|
| BF16 + QAT | BF16, fake quant (quantize-dequantize + STE) on weight / act / KV in the rollout format | no | quantizer parity with rollout kernels; QAT noise raises gradient variance |
| Real low-precision compute | FP8 / MXFP8 / MXFP4 / NVFP4 GEMMs (e.g. TE), FP32 master weights | yes | rowwise/columnwise copies per format; low-precision FSDP all-gather; train/rollout format alignment |

**Where FP32 master weights live** decides the backend design:
- In the optimizer (Megatron): model holds BF16 or low-precision compute weights, cast once per optimizer step on the
  local shard; easy to keep low-precision params persistent.
- In the model (FSDP2 / VeOmni): model holds sharded FP32 params, cast to compute dtype at every all-gather; any optimizer
  works, high-precision weights always available (checkpoint, weight sync), cast cost repeats per micro-batch.

**Formats**
| Format | Block | Scale | fprop / dgrad see the same W | HW |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| FP8 per-tensor | tensor | FP32 | yes | Hopper+ |
| FP8 blockwise | A 1x128, W 128x128 | FP32 or pow2 | yes for W (2D block) | Hopper |
| MXFP8 | 1x32 | E8M0 | no (rowwise and columnwise quantized separately) | Blackwell |
| MXFP4 | 1x32 | E8M0 | no | Blackwell (Hopper via FP4->FP8 dequant) |
| NVFP4 | 1x16 + per-tensor FP32 | E4M3 | yes when weight uses 16x16 2D (TE default) | Blackwell |

**DeepSeek V4 / V4.1 reference**
- MXFP4 QAT for routed experts and the indexer QK path; FP32 master -> FP4 -> lossless dequant to FP8 128x128, so
  training reuses the FP8 framework and dgrad uses the same W as fprop (V4 §3.4).
- Real FP4 weights for rollout, ref and teacher forwards (V4 §5.2.1).
- KV cache: FP8 + BF16 RoPE dims (V4 §2.3.4); FP4 main KV cache QAT, SWA KV stays FP8 (V4.1 §2.4.4).
- Comm: BF16 + stochastic rounding for MoE grad sync, all-to-all + local FP32 sum (V4 §3.5.1).
- Batch-invariant / deterministic kernels for bitwise train/infer alignment (V4 §3.3).

### Existing
#### BF16 + QAT
[NVFP4 QAT (Quantization-Aware Training) in verl](https://verl.readthedocs.io/en/latest/low_precision/nvfp4_qat.html)
| Backend | QAT format (training) | Rollout format | Implementation | Verified |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| FSDP | NVFP4 W4A16 (group 16) | NVFP4 W4A16, vLLM `compressed-tensors` | `verl/utils/qat/` | Qwen3-8B-Base, Qwen3-30B-A3B-Base |
| Megatron | NVFP4 W4A16 (group 16) | NVFP4 W4A16, vLLM `modelopt` | `verl/utils/modelopt/` | Qwen3-8B-Base, Qwen3-30B-A3B-Base |
| VeOmni | FP8 blockwise (W 128x128, A 1x128; linear / KV NoPE / indexer QK / MoE) + FP4 1x32 routed experts | FP8 blockwise + MXFP4 experts, vLLM `Mxfp4MoEMethod` refit | `veomni/ops/qat/`, `verl/utils/vllm/vllm_fp4_utils.py` | [DeepSeek-V4-Flash](https://github.com/ByteDance-Seed/VeOmni/pull/1089) |

#### Real low-precision compute
[FP8 RL in verl](https://verl.readthedocs.io/en/latest/low_precision/fp8.html)
| Backend | Mode | Training compute | Rollout compute | Implementation | Verified |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| FSDP | rollout-only | BF16 | FP8 blockwise, vLLM / SGLang / TRT-LLM | `{vllm,sglang}/*fp8_utils.py` | Qwen3-8B-Base, Qwen3-30B-A3B-Base |
| Megatron | rollout-only | BF16 | FP8 blockwise, vLLM / SGLang / TRT-LLM | same as above | Qwen3-30B-A3B |
| Megatron | E2E | FP8 blockwise via TE (`fp8: hybrid`, `fp8_recipe: blockwise`) + FP8 optimizer | FP8 blockwise, vLLM | Megatron-Bridge + TE | Qwen3-8B, Qwen3-30B-A3B (Hopper); on Blackwell TE runs blockwise as MXFP8 ([#6172](https://github.com/verl-project/verl/issues/6172)) |
| VeOmni | - | - | - | - | not supported |

### Q4 Plan
| Priority | Common | Megatron | VeOmni |
|---|---|---|---|
| P0 | train/rollout quantizer parity | DeepSeek-V4 FP4->FP8 lossless path | DeepSeek-V4/V4.1 QAT E2E |
| P1 | unified recipe config; low-precision inference-only forwards; low-precision comm | Blackwell MXFP8 E2E; Blackwell NVFP4 training | torchao low-precision compute + FSDP2 all-gather; torchao NVFP4/MXFP4 QAT |
| P2 | batch-invariant / deterministic kernels | FP8 optimizer states; MoE W4A8 | Muon + BF16 Newton-Schulz |

#### Common @wuxibin89 
- [x] P0 Train/rollout quantizer parity: same quantizer + scale fmt (ue8m0/e4m3), report mismatch KL & rollout throughput https://github.com/verl-project/verl/pull/8287 https://github.com/verl-project/verl/pull/8306 https://github.com/verl-project/verl/pull/8308 https://github.com/verl-project/verl/pull/8498 https://github.com/verl-project/verl/pull/8500
- [x] P1 Unified low-precision recipe config across FSDP/VeOmni/Megatron/Automodel
  - today: `rollout.quantization`, `megatron.override_transformer_config.fp8*`, `fsdp_config.qat`, `megatron.qat`, veomni `qat_implementation`, automodel `enable_fp8`
  - recipe = train compute fmt + QAT (weight/act/KV fmt, modules) + rollout fmt; fail fast on train/rollout fmt mismatch
- [ ] P1 Batch-invariant / deterministic train+rollout kernels for bitwise alignment

#### Megatron @ISEEKYAN @wuxibin89 
Route: Megatron-LM + TransformerEngine, master weights in the optimizer.
- Compute weights are BF16, or FP8/MXFP8 with `fp8_param` / `fp8_param_gather`; DistributedOptimizer / Megatron-FSDP
  keep sharded FP32 main params and cast back after each step.
- TE provides the low-precision GEMMs and recipes (per-tensor delayed/current, blockwise, MXFP8, NVFP4) and the
  rowwise/columnwise copies; under MXFP8, Megatron-FSDP gathers rowwise for fprop and columnwise for dgrad.
- QAT goes through modelopt; HF <-> mcore weights and FP8 export go through Megatron-Bridge.
- Fit: large-scale MoE (TP/PP/EP/CP), mature FP8 stack. Cost: new models need mcore / Bridge support.

- [ ] P0 Modern Megatron integration: https://github.com/verl-project/verl/issues/8324
- [ ] P0 DeepSeek-V4 FP4->FP8 lossless path: FP4 fake quant in FP32 master -> FP8 (128x128) cast, reuse TE blockwise + `fp8_param_gather` (V4 §3.4)
  - 2D 128x128 block => fprop/dgrad use the same W, no re-quant of W^T
  - monitor max/min FP4 sub-block scale ratio per 128x128 block, fallback when lossless condition breaks
- [x] P1 Blackwell MXFP8 E2E: TE MXFP8 + `fp8_param_gather` + `reuse_grad_buf_for_mxfp8_param_ag`
  - resolve train MXFP8 (1x32, fprop/dgrad W differ) vs rollout blockwise 128x128 (DeepGEMM) format mismatch https://github.com/verl-project/verl/pull/8127
- [x] P1 Blackwell NVFP4 training: TE NVFP4 recipe (16x16 2D weight, RHT, SR) + vLLM NVFP4 W4A4 rollout https://github.com/verl-project/verl/pull/7971 https://github.com/verl-project/verl/pull/8494
- [ ] P2 FP8 optimizer states, MoE W4A8 (FP4 x FP8 GEMM) https://github.com/verl-project/verl/pull/8426

#### VeOmni @wuxibin89 @FoolPlayer @amenomori 
Route: FSDP2 + torchao, master weights in the model.
- Model holds sharded FP32 params; FSDP2 `MixedPrecisionPolicy` casts each shard to BF16 at all-gather; any standard
  optimizer works unchanged.
- QAT is VeOmni's own fake-quant ops (`veomni/ops/qat/`, STE) wired into patchgen-generated HF modeling, which makes
  new models (e.g. DeepSeek-V4) quick to bring up.
- Real low-precision compute is to come from torchao: float8 / MX linear, plus float8 FSDP2 all-gather that quantizes
  the high-precision shard before gather (low-precision comm without persistent low-precision weights).
- Fit: HF-native models, fast model bring-up, flexible recipes. Cost: no low-precision compute yet; current TileLang
  QAT kernels are SM90 + BF16 only.

- [ ] P0 DeepSeek-V4/V4.1 QAT E2E (blocks Model Support: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash)
- [ ] P1 torchao low-precision compute: float8 (tensorwise/rowwise), MXFP8 on Blackwell
  - low-precision FSDP2 all-gather: quantize sharded high-precision weights before gather (float8 / MXFP8)
- [ ] P1 torchao fake-quant QAT for NVFP4 / MXFP4

## Model Support
- [ ] DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash
- [ ] Qwen3.8-Flash-Next
- [ ] GLM-5.3-Flash

## Score Centering
- [x] vllm+FSDP: https://github.com/verl-project/verl/pull/8010 https://github.com/verl-project/verl/pull/8196
- [x] Megatron: https://github.com/verl-project/verl/pull/8199
- [ ] sglang support
- [ ] fuse CE kernel: https://github.com/verl-project/verl/pull/8654
- [ ] recipe&doc: https://github.com/verl-project/verl/pull/8644

# Rollout
## Async rollout
- [ ] P0 Token-level interrupt + persist KV cache / routing across weight switch, no re-prefill on resume
- [ ] P1 Sample-level dispatch: dispatch next prompt once #completed samples >= group size https://github.com/verl-project/verl/pull/8203

## Weight refit optimization
- [ ] Delta shard support for quantized `(weight, scale)`
- [ ] NCCL/NIXL M2N reshard https://github.com/verl-project/verl/pull/8088 https://github.com/verl-project/verl/pull/8395

## Performance optimization
- Load balance: session-affinity routing for multi-turn agents
- Centralized kv-cache pooling
- kv-cache offload

## Fault tolerance
Target on v1 `separate_async` mode: @HaoWang113 @ETOgaosion @tongyx361 
- RFC: https://github.com/verl-project/verl/issues/8380
- [ ] Rollout replica restart without interrupting trainer
- [ ] Trainer restart without interrupting rollout
- [ ] Sandbox recover on restart

## Uni-Agent
[Uni-Agent Q4 roadmap](https://github.com/verl-project/uni-agent/issues/191)

# Accelerator support
We will keep enhancing multi-accelerator support: built-in for NVIDIA / Ascend / AMD, and out-of-tree for others via
[verl-hardware-plugin](https://github.com/verl-project/verl-hardware-plugin).

## Huawei Ascend
Huawei Ascend NPU Q4 roadmap: [Huawei Ascend verl Q4 roadmap](https://github.com/verl-project/verl/issues/8304)

## AMD ROCm
- [ ] AMD Q4 roadmap: https://github.com/verl-project/verl/issues/8537
- [x] ROCm platform backend [#6702](https://github.com/verl-project/verl/pull/6702), MI300 e2e CI [#6668](https://github.com/verl-project/verl/pull/6668)
- [x] DeepSeek-V4-Flash GRPO on AMD GPUs [#7050](https://github.com/verl-project/verl/pull/7050), on MI355X with QAT / FP8 / BF16 [#8146](https://github.com/verl-project/verl/pull/8146)

## Google TPU
- [x] Ray TPU resource discovery [#7849](https://github.com/verl-project/verl/pull/7849), SFT with TorchTitan engine [#8098](https://github.com/verl-project/verl/pull/8098)
- [x] Plugin: TPU platform [plugin#18](https://github.com/verl-project/verl-hardware-plugin/pull/18), TorchTitan TPU engine [plugin#31](https://github.com/verl-project/verl-hardware-plugin/pull/31), vLLM rollout on multi-host TPU [plugin#34](https://github.com/verl-project/verl-hardware-plugin/pull/34), Raiden P2P weight sync [plugin#37](https://github.com/verl-project/verl-hardware-plugin/pull/37)
- [x] GRPO with TorchTitan + vLLM via plugin [#8155](https://github.com/verl-project/verl/pull/8155)

# Trainer
- [ ] Deprecate `verl/experimental/fully_async_policy|one_step_off_policy` to verl-recipe https://github.com/verl-project/verl/pull/8625
- [ ] Remove V0 trainer `verl/trainer/ppo/ray_trainer.py`

verl-omni Q4 roadmap: https://github.com/verl-project/verl-omni/issues/700

# rl-insight

issues.title: [Project] deepseek R1 infrastructure
issues.body:
The verl team like to invite the community to help contribute to build infrastructure to efficiently scale up to models of deepseek scale and develop recipes to reproduce deepseek r1 results for the broader open source and research community. You're encouraged to join the slack channel for discussions on sub-topics.

# Evals

Tasks: https://github.com/volcengine/verl/pull/777/files 
- add evaluation script to reproduce ds-r1 results on several benchmarks from ds-r1 checkpoint
  - [x] gpqa diamond (english)
  - [x] LiveCodeBench (code)
  - [x] SWE-bench Verified (code)
  - [x] CNMO 2024 (math)

Notes:
- refer to `examples/data_preprocess` for data preprocessing examples
- refer to trainer/main_generation.py for generation (but evaluation code is missing)
- if possible, upload preprocessed dataset to huggingface
- start with ds distilled models for quick verification before scaling up to 671b

# Training engine 
Tasks: 
- verify `GPTModel` with mcore v0.11. There’s experimental integration of critic and actor models with GPTModel class
  - [x] verify checkpoint manager with GPTModel 
  - [x] Investigate the issue of convergence issue of seq packing when micro bsz > 1 @GAIR-NLP 
Mcore ds-v3 perf tuning 
  - [ ] Run ds-v3 with mcore on a range of seqlen and GPU count, tune nd parallel / memory configs 
- Mcore ds-v3 convergence verification: to ensure the correctness of mcore ds-v3 implementation, we shall run a smaller version of ds with same model architecture. 
  - [x] obtain a medium-sized MOE pretrained ckpt
  - [x] Compare mcore convergence with FSDP + medium-sized MOE
  - [x] Verify mcore expert parallelism correctness https://github.com/volcengine/verl/pull/1467
  - [ ] Optimize ds-v3 long context throughout with FSDP backend for faster FSDP experiment iterations (e.g. liger alignment loss, recompute strategy, ring attn). 
  - [ ] Run 671b https://github.com/volcengine/verl/pull/1771

Notes:
- To make the perf tuning more faithful, it’s better to develop a benchmark script that include alignment loss (CE loss, CE and entropy loss) 
- GAIR NLP team is looking GPTModel with sequence packing support when micro_bsz > 1

# Data & recipe 

Tasks:
Math and scientific sources:  
- [ ] Further improve the dataset used for math RL, maybe based on DAPO 17k and other open source ones
Code:
- [ ] Build a baseline code recipe in verl main repo, using small models such as llama or qwen-7b
- [ ] Curate dataset for code RL training (start with existing open source ones) 

Notes:
- Provide reproducible command and logs in https://verl.readthedocs.io/en/latest/experiment/ppo.html 

# Inference Engine
Tasks
-  [x] verify multi-node TP inference
- [ ] support multi-node EP/PP inference
-  [x] sharding manager support with mcore v0.11 + latest version of inference engines 

Related TODOs: https://github.com/volcengine/verl/issues/825
